relations.justification: Applied mathematics uses the structures pure mathematics establishes; the modelling step assumes them.
Modern pure mathematics is stated set-theoretically and its foundations are a logical question.
Field theory is stated in vector calculus and partial differential equations.
Computational mathematics discretises the continuous problems applied mathematics poses.
Machine learning is optimisation over parameterised function classes; the analysis is applied mathematics.
Econometric estimators are linear algebra and asymptotic theory.
Computational chemistry is numerical linear algebra and optimisation applied to the Schrodinger equation.
Numerical methods support weather and climate modelling; the forecast is a discretised solution.
Numerical algorithms are algorithms; stability and conditioning are the numerical analogue of complexity.
Physics is stated in mathematics; the calculus of change is a precondition for mechanics, not an application of it.
Theoretical computer science is a branch of discrete mathematics and cannot be approached without it.
Entropy is an expectation over a probability distribution; probability is prior to information theory.
Econometrics is applied probability and linear algebra.
Asymptotic analysis of algorithms is a complexity-theoretic notion applied to concrete procedures.
Decidability defines the boundary computational logic operates within.
Indexing and query planning are algorithm and data-structure design under a storage constraint.
Learning algorithms are algorithms; the optimisation and complexity vocabulary is prior.
Bioinformatics is algorithm design over biological sequence data.
Delivery pipelines automate the build-test-release cycle software engineering defines.
Operating a database presupposes the transaction, index and query theory that database systems supply.
Network stacks are implemented as operating-system services; sockets and scheduling come first.
A container is an operating-system construct — namespaces and cgroups — before it is a packaging format.
Network security presupposes the protocol layering it attacks and defends.
Proxies, load balancers and gateways are network functions; the layering model is prior to the components that sit in it.
Cryptography is number theory and algebra put to an adversarial purpose.
Practical cryptography exemplifies the gap between information-theoretic and computational secrecy.
Applied cryptography specialises information-theoretic security to the computational setting where the guarantees are weaker but achievable.
Defence in depth in security engineering and layered regulatory obligation are the same design: no single control is trusted to hold.
Security operations applies the threat model and cryptographic primitives that computer security establishes.
Artificial neural networks were named for and loosely modelled on neural architecture; the analogy is real at the level of weighted summation and useless below it.
Machine learning derives from statistics and optimisation; the algorithms are estimators under another name.
A learning system requires a stated loss and a hypothesis class; without them "learning" has no criterion of success.
Purely predictive machine learning contradicts the explanatory ideal the philosophy of science holds: a model that predicts without a mechanism does not explain.
Reliability is engineered against measured behaviour; without observability an error budget has no numerator.
What a telemetry signal is worth depends on how much it reduces uncertainty about system state; sampling and cardinality decisions are information-theoretic ones.
Observability and negative feedback are the same loop: a system without a sensor cannot be regulated, and the metric IS the error signal.
Security operations rests on knowing who a caller is; without identity, audit records an anonymous event.
Identity systems process personal data and require a lawful basis; an SSO deployment is a data-protection decision.
Access control and archival access restriction answer the same question in two vocabularies: who may see what, and on whose authority.
Estate management is delivery repeated across many coupled services, and the coupling is what makes it its own problem.
Repeatable delivery requires written procedure; an undocumented pipeline is one person's knowledge with a cron schedule.
Containerisation exemplifies modularity: isolate a unit with its dependencies so that what is inside cannot perturb what is outside.
Service topology and cascading failure are one subject — a retry storm is contagion on the call graph.
Service infrastructure and telecommunications network architecture are the same layering applied at different scales.
Data infrastructure requires a tested restore, not a backup job — the same rule digital preservation states, and the one most often skipped.
Operational backup and digital preservation are the same practice at different horizons, and both fail the same way: an unverified restore.
A service objective requires measurement to be stated against; an SLO without telemetry is an aspiration.
Reliability engineering is applied resilience: error budgets are an explicit statement of how much disturbance the system is designed to absorb.
Incident command in operations was taken directly from emergency medicine — triage, a single commander and a handover protocol.
Security operations requires the incident regime it must report under; detection without a reporting path is a legal exposure as well as a technical one.
An estate and an organisation face the same coordination problem — coupled units, a shared upgrade path, and a cost to every boundary drawn.
Self-hosting takes on the controller obligations a managed provider would otherwise carry, including the machinery for data-subject requests.
Platform engineering specialises software engineering to the operation of systems rather than their construction.
Formal proof defines what counts as established in pure mathematics.
Mathematical logic supplies proof, set and quantifier notation that formal mathematics is written in.
Computability and complexity are stated in the logical vocabulary of decidability and proof.
Computational logic is logic constrained by what a machine can decide.

Shannon entropy and thermodynamic entropy are the same functional form over a probability distribution; Shannon adopted the name on that basis and the identification is exact up to Boltzmann's constant.
Entropy defines the compression limit — the source coding theorem is the statement that the bound is exactly the entropy.
Mutual information is what makes requisite variety quantitative: the regulator must carry at least the information the disturbance contains.
Relative entropy and mutual information are two readings of one quantity — mutual information is the divergence between joint and product distributions.
Source coding bounds are stated in entropy; compression cannot be motivated before the measure exists.
Channel capacity is a mutual-information maximisation and presupposes the information measures.
Information measures generalise the notion of evidence that inference quantifies, though the statistical and information-theoretic accounts are not interchangeable.
Compression and prediction are the same problem: a model that predicts well codes short, and minimum description length makes the identity explicit.
Rate-distortion is stated as a minimisation of mutual information subject to a distortion constraint; the measure is constitutive of the statement.
Rate-distortion and quantisation are the theory and the practice of the same trade: bits against fidelity.
Perceptual coding and the physiology of sensory thresholds are the same fact used twice — compression discards what the receiver cannot detect.
Universal coding superseded fixed-model coding in general-purpose use by removing the requirement to know the source distribution in advance.
Computed and universal methods superseded precomputed tables for most working purposes, though the tables remain the reference record.
Channel capacity and transport limits are both maximum-throughput results derived from a statistical description of a noisy medium.
Error-correcting codes and DNA proofreading are the same strategy — redundancy plus detection — arrived at independently.
Algorithmic information refutes the claim that probability alone grounds randomness: a single string has no probability, and incompressibility supplies the missing criterion.
Algorithmic information refutes the sufficiency of the probabilistic account for single objects: entropy is undefined for one string, Kolmogorov complexity is not.
Algorithmic randomness and thermodynamic disorder both identify the incompressible with the typical — a microstate needing full description is one of the overwhelming majority.
Fourier decomposition is the shared mathematics of signal analysis and wave physics; the transform is one object used under two names.
Time and frequency representations are a transform pair — information present in one is fully recoverable from the other, and the sampling theorem is the bridge.
Vector representation generalises the embedding step every modern learning system performs.
A useful embedding requires a defensible measure of what it should preserve; without one, "close" has no criterion.
A feedback loop is defined over a system boundary; the boundary must be drawn before the loop can be traced.
A network is a system described by its connections; the system vocabulary comes first.
Systems and boundaries generalise organisational structure: an org chart is a boundary drawing with a coordination cost.
Negative feedback regulation and physiological homeostasis are one mechanism described in two vocabularies — setpoint, error signal, effector.
Negative and positive feedback are the same mechanism with opposite sign, and most real systems are an arrangement of both.
Positive feedback destabilises: a self-reinforcing loop moves a system away from equilibrium until a limit intervenes.
Positive feedback in participation is what turns scattered grievance into a movement; the threshold model is the standard account.
Positive feedback between asset prices and credit is the mechanism of the boom-bust cycle financial stability policy tries to damp.
Equilibrium in dynamical systems and market equilibrium share the fixed-point formalism; both are stationary under the adjustment process that defines them.
Control theory generalises the feedback a robot implements to any regulated system.
Delay between action and effect converts a stabilising loop into an oscillating one — the classic cause of overshoot in regulated systems.
Requisite variety is a statement about regulators, which feedback and control define.
Control theory generalises the feedback loops a robot implements; robotics is one instantiation.
Deterministic chaos was discovered in atmospheric modelling; weather is the canonical system where sensitivity to initial conditions bounds prediction.
Business cycles exemplify nonlinear dynamics with delay; the oscillation is structural rather than a sequence of shocks.
Self-organisation and chemical pattern formation are one phenomenon; reaction-diffusion is the canonical demonstration.
Adaptation in complex systems and biological evolution are the same selection-variation-retention loop; evolutionary theory is the worked case.
System resilience and herd immunity are both thresholds: below a level of protection the disturbance propagates, above it dies out.
Resilience generalises disaster recovery: the capacity to absorb disturbance without regime change is the same property at any scale.
Power-law behaviour in complex systems and heavy-tailed return distributions in finance share the scale-invariance that makes extreme events far more likely than a normal model predicts.
Market crashes exemplify heavy-tailed behaviour: the extreme event is far likelier than a normal model admits and is not an anomaly.
Network topology and social-capital structure are the same object: weak ties are low-clustering bridges, and the strength-of-weak-ties result is a statement about graph structure.
Network diffusion and epidemic transmission use the same compartmental mathematics; the basic reproduction number is a threshold on the contact graph.
Cascading failure across coupled infrastructure is what turns a bounded hazard into a wide-area disaster.
Requisite variety and channel capacity are both statements that a regulator or channel must match the variety it must absorb.
Systems thinking and the policy cycle describe the same loop: intervention, effect, feedback and adjustment, with the same tendency for the loop to be broken by delay.
Cybernetics and information theory developed in the same post-war moment and share the concept of a signal carrying control.
